children: Shares of SG Mart Ltd. are in focus on Monday, November 23, after the company said its board is set to meet on Thursday, November 26, to approve the proposal for raising funds.

The company informed the exchanges on Sunday regarding the same. The proposal is to raise funds via issue of one or more instruments — equity shares/convertible securities either by way of preferential issue, rights issue, qualified institutional placement (QIP) or any other method or combination, the exchange filing stated.

SG Mart delivered its second quarter results last month. Its revenue of ₹156 crore was down 8% from last year but was up 19% sequentially. Its net profit came in at ₹54 crore, up 104% from the previous fiscal and 19% from the previous quarter as well.

The company's investor presentation stated that its earnings before interest taxes depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) came in at ₹72 crore, up 157% from the previous year and 23% from the prior fiscal. It added that its EBITDA margin expanded to 4.6% from ₹297 basis points from the year-ago period and 12 basis points from last quarter.
SG Mart shares ended the previous session 7.2% up at ₹1,083.15 apiece. The stock has risen for nine out of the previous 10 trading sessions.
SG Mart operates in B2B metal trading, steel service centers, and downstream distribution, serving EPC contractors, real estate developers, OEMs, dealers, and retails.
The company's product portfolio includes TMT Bars, structural steel, HR coils / sheets, binding wire, welding rods, fasteners, electrical and home appliances as well.
The stock has risen 36% in the past month, 76.8% in the last six months and 182.8% this year, so far.

title: SG Mart shares in focus as board to meet this week to consider fund raising proposal
